args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Incident opened to track investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an elevated error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — verified as `rolled_out` (v2.3.0 now live in us-east, us-west, eu-west).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and the need to investigate the v2.3.1 regression.

No change-manager approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version, not a new deployment.
